discountTest.sourceOfTruth: No code is kept in the repo or printed on the site. The checkout E2E runs a discount only in Stripe test mode, with a code the operator passes in LOCAL_E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE; against live Stripe it refuses (scripts/ops/checkout-e2e-discount-guard.mjs).
discountTest.expectedCheckoutResult: test mode only: completed Checkout Session with payment_status=no_payment_required and amount_total=0
discountTest.expectedFulfillmentResult: verify-download returns protected PDF and DOCX download links

products.name: Letter of Explanation Kit
needs: Buyer can arrive from home Products grid, use-case rail, product page, or pricing page.
CTA should send SKU letter-of-explanation and optional discount code only.
Stripe Checkout must create a payment session using the matching test/live price ID.
Promo code field is optional and names no code; a discount is tested only in Stripe test mode or with the fixture, never with a live 100% off code.
After completed payment or completed 100% off session, success page must unlock protected PDF and DOCX links.
Buyer chooses either direct DOCX/PDF download or optional browser-only Studio prefill; no required pre-purchase intake.
Buyer reviews placeholders, edits truthfully, attaches real documents where appropriate, and sends materials themselves.
